name: Nike Barcelona Kids Training Dri-Fit Strike

description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike Children's Training Sweatshirt 2026 2027 - Purple
description.tagline: Train like the FCB with the Mamba mentality
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Dri-Fit Strike training children's sweatshirt is designed for those who seek the highest demands in each workout. Inspired by the connection between Kobe Bryant and FC Barcelona, ​​it combines a purple design with a high-performance fit to prepare each session at the highest level.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Wicks sweat away to keep you dry and comfortable.
Elastic fabric: Allows freedom of movement in every action.
Thumbholes: Keep sleeves in place during movement.
FC Barcelona Design: Inspired by the legacy of Kobe Bryant and the club's competitive identity.
